mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (current value) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the discount rate for equity valuation and increase the attractiveness of equities relative to bonds.
failure_condition: The correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20d SPX returns is not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.0%) predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as elevated unemployment signals economic weakness and reduced corporate earnings potential.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC for UNRATE > 5.0% is < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of declining housing starts (HOUST < 1900) and rising unemployment (UNRATE > 4.5%) predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as these indicators signal a weakening housing market and labor market, reducing economic growth expectations.
failure_condition: The combined signal (HOUST < 1900 and UNRATE > 4.5%) fails to predict negative returns in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%), negative S&P 500 forward returns are predicted over the next 20 trading days, as high inflation typically triggers monetary tightening by the Fed, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%, or the Rank IC for the high inflation regime is < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high industrial production index (current value) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as strong industrial output signals robust economic growth and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The correlation between INDPRO and 20d SPX returns is not significantly positive (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low housing starts index (HOUST < 1900) predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as weak housing activity signals a slowing economy and reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1900, or the Rank IC for HOUST < 1900 is < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of declining employment (PAYEMS < 134000) and rising unemployment (UNRATE > 4.5%) predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as these indicators signal a deteriorating labor market, reducing consumer confidence and spending.
failure_condition: The combined signal (PAYEMS < 134000 and UNRATE > 4.5%) fails to predict negative returns in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low GDP growth regime (GDPC1 annualized growth rate < 0.5%), negative S&P 500 forward returns are predicted over the next 60 trading days, as weak economic growth reduces corporate earnings and investor risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 annualized growth rate < 0.5%, or the Rank IC for the low GDP growth regime is < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
